Task.title: Task
Task.description: Represents an automated AI Worker freelancing task requiring approval or monitoring.

title.description: The title or action name of the AI worker task.

category.description: The category of the task (e.g. Client Acquisition, Deliverable, Outreach, Proposal).

workerName.description: The identifier of the AI worker agent assigned to this task.

workerRole.description: Role specialty of the AI worker (e.g. SEO Specialist, Lead Generator).

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the task.

client.description: The prospective client or target platform.

estimatedValue.description: Estimated revenue or dollar value of the completed task.

rejectionReason.description: Reason provided by user if rejected.

logs.description: Recent execution logs or telemetry from the AI worker.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp. Must be FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: AI worker tasks owned by the authenticated freelancer agency user.
